description:
Target A item A-3 (docs/v2-endgame-plan.md §6; measured catalogue docs/faster-codegen-suggestions.md §7 + §11.4). p-method-call's string-keyed pkg/@ISA walk + *wantarray* bind is ~15× slower than a plain sub call (m_method 2.62s vs m_subcall 0.18s @ 2M). Fix: per-call-site cache cell (load-time-value cons/2-slot vector); p-call-cached compares invocant class to cached class → direct call on hit, resolve+patch on miss (runtime redefinition = automatic miss; no sealed world, no whole-program analysis). Wrap in the named macro from day one (Target B convergence). Also fold in M2 (hoist %pcl-cl-sub-name out of the MRO walk — existing memory TODO) as the miss-path constant-factor lift. Independent of E2–E5; verify with bench-exec.pl + an OO bench row + full gate/sweep.

MEASURED s444 (Fable, sb-sprof on a 2M-call monomorphic loop, probe files scratchpad fable-meth*.{pl,lisp}): the 15x is NOT lookup-dominated and the USER asked for a cache-free design first.  Breakdown: ~45% = sb-pcl::update-class/%update-cpl under a recursive LOCK -- p-method-call calls sb-mop:finalize-inheritance on EVERY call (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~15335); ~15-20% = per-call string manufacture (%pcl-invert-case, %pcl-cl-sub-name "pl-NAME" concat per MRO element, perl-pkg-to-clos-class "plc-foo", the SUPER::/:: subseq+search scans); ~10-15% = find-package/find-symbol from scratch (find-package called 2-3x per call); rest = p-flatten-args consing + protocol.  VERIFIED: guarding finalize with class-finalized-p is 2.7s -> 1.2s on the loop (2.2x, one line, no cache).  REVISED CACHE-FREE PLAN (before any inline cache): (1) the finalize-once guard; (2) store the STASH (package object) in the box at bless time instead of the class-name STRING -- perl's own SvSTASH design; ref() keeps the orig-case name via the existing out-of-band carry; (3) fast path: try find-symbol of the pre-built pl-NAME in the invocant's own package BEFORE any SUPER::/qualified/CLOS machinery; scan for :: once with position; (4) M2 as filed: hoist pl-NAME out of the MRO walk, and have codegen pass it pre-built so runtime does ZERO string work.  A cache remains justified ONLY for inherited methods found up the MRO -- and then perl's own shape: a per-CLASS stash table invalidated at the mutation points (p-sub define, glob assign,  write), NOT a per-call-site cell; no per-call guard, emission unchanged (Target B).  CAUTION: box-representation change -> the sweep IS the gate; probe ref()/glob stringification (#423 family) before shipping (2).

FIRST CUT SHIPPED s444 (81c17ea, USER: "ship the one-line fix, then #73 to the next round"): the finalize-once guard at BOTH sites (p-method-call + p-super-call).  Loop 2.7s -> 1.2s (2.2x); ovlsub 7.27x -> 5.28x; sweep clean 18313 (+0); companion mro/class/method legs byte-identical; runtime-only, no gen bump.  REMAINDER FOR THE NEXT AGENT ROUND (USER-scheduled), in order per the s444 measurement: (2) stash-in-box at bless (representation change -- the sweep IS the gate; probe ref()/glob stringification, #423 family), (3) own-package fast path before SUPER::/qualified/CLOS machinery, (4) pre-built pl-NAME from codegen (M2 superset; emission change -> gen bump + A/B), then ONLY IF inherited dispatch still lags: the per-CLASS stash table (perl's own shape, invalidated at p-sub define / glob assign / @ISA write) -- NOT a per-call-site cell.  #533 is the SUPER::/UNIVERSAL fallback found by the probes.

SHIPPED s446m (Opus, agent M; commits f9890c2 + 1ed8f68, runtime-only, no gen bump): step (3) the OWN-PACKAGE FAST PATH -- a plain method name found in the invocant's own class package returns immediately, sharing p-method-call's prologue so a decline costs one failed FIND-SYMBOL; it is the same function both slow paths would reach, since the CLOS MRO and the @ISA walk each start at the class itself.  Plus, from the same profile: THE STASH TABLE (%pcl-find-package memoized -- perl's gv_stashpv shape; only successful resolutions recorded, and a CL package is never renamed or deleted, so no entry can go stale), %pcl-cl-sub-name memoized (M2 generalised) AND hoisted so p-method-call/p-super-call build the pl-NAME once per call instead of once per class visited, a no-cons SUPER:: prefix test, the qualified-name question asked once, the plc-NAME CLOS symbol built only when the CLOS branch can be taken, (declare (type string method-name)) -- 12% on its own -- and the @ISA walk STARTING AT THE PARENTS when the fast path has already missed in the class's own package (cleared when the auto-require runs, CORE excluded).  A memo key is copied when stored (%pcl-memo-key): a Perl string can be a str-buffer the program appends to in place.

MEASURED (2M calls, startup+compile subtracted, best-of-5, perl ~0.145 s; agent-M benches m-bench-meth/inh/sub): monomorphic $o->v() 1.2537 -> 0.3802 s (3.30x, 9.05x -> 2.62x of perl); inherited through @ISA 1.8567 -> 0.7115 s (2.61x, 13.29x -> 4.74x); plain sub call control unchanged ~0.21 s.  bench-exec ovlsub 4.98x -> 3.44x (0.2078 -> 0.1620 s); intloop/arrhash/fib controls unmoved.  Gate green 172 files / 5916 rows; 23 runtime-redefinition probe rows byte-identical to perl; guard Pl/t/method-dispatch-01.t.

STEPS (2) AND (4) ARE MEASURED AND NOT SHIPPED -- do not retry them for speed.  With the memos and the type declaration in place, making BOTH remaining lookups free (a one-element eq cache in front of each, applied to this tree and reverted) is worth 0.3802 -> 0.3534 s on the monomorphic loop (7%) and NOTHING measurable on the inherited one (0.7115 -> 0.7059, inside the noise).  So: (2) stash-in-box does not earn a box-representation change -- the class slot is read at ~40 sites woven through ref()/stringification (p-ref's arm list, %p-target-class, the :__class__ hash key, cl/pcl-xs.lisp), and PCL's ref() must keep the spelling the program blessed with, which a package object cannot carry (see #580 for the one place perl DOES canonicalise); the stash TABLE captures its performance intent at zero representation risk.  (4) codegen passing the pre-built pl-NAME does not earn an emission change either: a new IR shape (a method-name designator), a generation bump, three artifact regenerations and an A/B for 7% of one loop.  If either is ever wanted again, it must be for a reason other than this benchmark.  THE REMAINING LEVER on inherited dispatch is the per-CLASS method cache, filed with its invalidation blocker as #582.

s445 (Fable) review of s446m: RATIFIED -- remainder shipped cache-free (fast path + stash/sub-name memos, monomorphic 2.62x / inherited 4.74x of perl, ovlsub 3.44x) and steps (2)/(4) CLOSED on the 7%/0% measurement; do not retry them for speed. #582 = the one remaining lever (per-CLASS cache, blocked on @ISA-write invalidation), scheduled post-v0.1.
subject: Perf M1: method-dispatch monomorphic inline cache (~15× measured)
